parent_objective: audit artifact-only outcome localization before choosing target consolidation, synthesis, or stop
blocked_by: M2447 localization needs audit before any target consolidation or scenario-quality decision
diagnostic axes must not become rankings
supersedes: ranking profiles, packs, families, or selected checkpoints from diagnostic slices

public_gates: M2448 must audit M2447 summary and localization rows
M2448 must decide whether localization is actionable enough for target consolidation, branch synthesis, stop, or another bounded route
M2448 must preserve diagnostic-only and non-ranking interpretation of profile/pack/family/checkpoint axes
M2448 must not rerun rollout, repair, train, rank, select winners, or make paper/current-sim/self-ID verdict claims
forbidden_shortcuts: do not rerun measured policy rollout
do not inject hidden or oracle actor features
do not claim actual success improvement
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not claim scenario redesign executed
do not claim training repair success

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits whether M2447 localization supports target consolidation, synthesis, stop, or another bounded route
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: localization result audit only; no rerun, repair, training, ranking, winner selection, paper verdict, finite-window-vs-GRU, level3 self-ID, scenario-redesign-executed, training-repair, or current-sim verdict claim
stop_condition: stop if localization is not actionable
stop if diagnostic axes would be misused as rankings
stop if next route is another narrow relabel without new evidence
fallback_plan: route to target consolidation if localization is actionable
route to branch synthesis if task-quality blocker is broad
stop for user review if no bounded route is supported

allowed_updates: M2448 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the audit
next_stage_criteria: M2447 localization is accepted or rejected
a bounded non-ranking next route is selected or the route is stopped

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2448 audits task-quality localization and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2448; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU verdict is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If localization shows broad task-quality blocker, synthesize or stop before repair/training.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, candidate-family ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, scenario-redesign-executed result, training-repair result, current-sim verdict, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: audits fresh measured localization before choosing next branch
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can decide whether to consolidate targets or synthesize the task-quality blocker
must_synthesize_if: audit cannot choose a bounded route
diagnostic axes are treated as ranking

hypothesis: Auditing M2447 can decide whether the artifact-only localization is actionable enough for target consolidation, synthesis, stop, or another bounded route without rerun, repair, training, ranking, or verdict claims.
success_criteria: M2447 summary and localization rows are audited
a bounded non-ranking next route is selected or the route is stopped
no rerun repair training ranking winner or verdict claim is made
failure_criteria: M2448 reruns measured validation or policy action
M2448 ranks candidate families, controller families, or selected checkpoints
M2448 makes current-sim, paper, FW-vs-GRU, self-ID, scenario-redesign, or training-repair verdict claims
decision_rule: M2448 passes if it audits M2447 and selects a bounded non-ranking next route or stops without rerun, repair, training, ranking, winner selection, or verdict claims.
